region: Africa (US-based digital banking for African customers; Nigeria focus)

customers.usage_stats: 50% drop in transaction volume/revenue in Q1 2025 due to compliance focus and high-risk customer removal. Conducted Upwork training for 4,500 people.

team.operation_notes: Conducted company offsite in Lagos with all team members; had 1 resignation (front-end engineer) in Q1, backfill already hired for Q2.

company_lowlights.description: Significant drop in transaction volume and revenue (~50%) in Q1.
company_lowlights.impact: Revenue and active transactions decreased due to removal of high-risk customers during compliance overhaul.
company_lowlights.future_changes: Positioned for healthier, more sustainable growth with stronger compliance.

company_lowlights.description: One resignation—a front-end engineer relocated and left the company.
company_lowlights.impact: Temporary gap in front-end role; backfill in place for Q2.
company_lowlights.future_changes: Backfill already hired and starts in Q2.

product_updates.description: Launched ability for customers to transfer Naira into accounts and convert to USD (NGN to USD conversions).
product_updates.impact: Met top customer feature request; supports saving/funding USD cards.

product_updates.description: Revamped website including improved landing page.
product_updates.impact: Improved first impressions and onboarding for prospective customers.

product_updates.description: Built enhanced liveness check flow ensuring all users complete liveness regardless of ID.
product_updates.impact: Strengthened KYC and fraud prevention process.

product_updates.description: OTA deployment for mobile fixes; enables background bug fixes without requiring app updates.
product_updates.impact: Improved user experience and reduced user complaints about frequent updates.

product_updates.description: Added transaction monitoring logic to flag high-risk keywords and suspicious USD deposit patterns.
Optimized data pipeline for faster metrics updates and reduced AWS cost (Zero ETL).
product_updates.impact: Improved data-driven reporting and cost efficiency.

product_updates.description: Integrated PostHog to track user activity in the app.
product_updates.impact: Enhanced analytics and ability to monitor user engagement/product performance.

events.description: Kicked off strategic partnerships with ALX and 3MTT, both organizations training new African tech talent.
Partnered with Univelcity, Telenvo, and Go My Code.
Completed and passed annual Data Protection Audit for Nigerian entities. Renewed IMTO license.
Nominated for Best Fintech in Africa at African Golden Awards 2025.
Held annual company offsite in Lagos, bringing all 30+ employees together.

notes: Q1 focus: compliance and de-risking led to 50% revenue and volume drop (not customer-driven churn). Kicked off partnerships (ALX, 3MTT, Univelcity, Telenvo, Go My Code). Upwork sessions for 4,500 people. Goals for Q2: increase PTO, mid-year bonus program, shift system revamp, launch loyalty program/business accounts, expansion into Ghana, South Africa, and Uganda. Team size at end of Q1: 34. Only 1 resignation, immediately backfilled.
